name: Iris
author: E. T. Carter
description: A giant eye iris filling the frame: hundreds of fine radial fibers run from a dark central pupil out past the corners, each wiggling slightly off a true radius. Fiber colour blends through the palette by angle, with a brighter collarette ring partway out and soft limbal darkening toward the far field. The pupil dilates and contracts on a long sinusoidal breath while fibers stretch radially to follow the moving aperture — the central negative space is the protagonist.

params.label: Fibers
params.effect: Number of radial fibers around the full circle; higher reads as silken fine grain, lower as distinct individual strands.

params.label: Breath speed
params.effect: Rate of the pupil's dilation cycle; minimum is a near-minute breath, maximum a noticeable slow pulse.

params.label: Wiggle
params.effect: Amplitude of each fiber's sideways waviness; 0 gives ruler-straight spokes, 1 gives loose silky strands.

params.label: Pupil size
params.effect: Mean pupil radius in CSS px around which the breath dilates and contracts.
